question: Find the IDs of players who scored the highest number of partnership runs for each match. The output should include the IDs of two players, each with their individual scores and the total partnership score. For each pair, the player with the higher individual score should be listed as player 1, and the player with the lower score as player 2. In cases where both players have the same score, the player with the higher ID should be player 1, and the player with the lower ID should be player 2. There can be multiple rows for a single match.
sql:
-- Final clean query
WITH ball_data AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id,
        b.innings_no,
        b.striker,
        b.non_striker,
        COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) AS runs_scored
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE b.striker IS NOT NULL AND b.non_striker IS NOT NULL
),
partnership_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        LEAST(striker, non_striker) AS p1,
        GREATEST(striker, non_striker) AS p2,
        SUM(runs_scored) AS partnership_total
    FROM ball_data
    GROUP BY match_id, LEAST(striker, non_striker), GREATEST(striker, non_striker)
),
max_partnership AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(partnership_total) AS max_runs
    FROM partnership_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
top_pairs AS (
    SELECT pr.match_id, pr.p1, pr.p2, pr.partnership_total
    FROM partnership_runs pr
    JOIN max_partnership mp ON pr.match_id = mp.match_id AND pr.partnership_total = mp.max_runs
),
striker_runs AS (
    SELECT match_id, striker AS player_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS individual_runs
    FROM ball_data
    GROUP BY match_id, striker
),
result AS (
    SELECT 
        tp.match_id,
        tp.p1,
        tp.p2,
        tp.partnership_total,
        COALESCE(sr1.individual_runs, 0) AS runs_p1,
        COALESCE(sr2.individual_runs, 0) AS runs_p2
    FROM top_pairs tp
    LEFT JOIN striker_runs sr1 ON tp.match_id = sr1.match_id AND tp.p1 = sr1.player_id
    LEFT JOIN striker_runs sr2 ON tp.match_id = sr2.match_id AND tp.p2 = sr2.player_id
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN runs_p1 > runs_p2 THEN p1 
            WHEN runs_p2 > runs_p1 THEN p2
            ELSE GREATEST(p1, p2)
        END AS player1,
        CASE 
            WHEN runs_p1 > runs_p2 THEN p2 
            WHEN runs_p2 > runs_p1 THEN p1
            ELSE LEAST(p1, p2)
        END AS player2,
        partnership_total,
        CASE 
            WHEN runs_p1 > runs_p2 THEN runs_p1
            WHEN runs_p2 > runs_p1 THEN runs_p2
            ELSE runs_p1
        END AS player1_runs,
        CASE 
            WHEN runs_p1 > runs_p2 THEN runs_p2
            WHEN runs_p2 > runs_p1 THEN runs_p1
            ELSE runs_p2
        END AS player2_runs
    FROM result
)
SELECT 
    match_id,
    CAST(player1 AS INTEGER) AS player1,
    CAST(player2 AS INTEGER) AS player2,
    CAST(player1_runs AS INTEGER) AS player1_runs,
    CAST(player2_runs AS INTEGER) AS player2_runs,
    CAST(partnership_total AS INTEGER) AS partnership_total
FROM ordered
ORDER BY match_id
